Journal-style ggplot theme

Source: R/lcz_theme.R
lcz_theme_journal.Rd

A minimal theme sized for final publication (Nature/Science column widths): left-aligned titles, no top/right spines, light horizontal grid, compact legend and 5-7 pt equivalent text.

Usage

lcz_theme_journal(
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "sans",
  grid = c("y", "both", "none"),
  legend = c("right", "top", "bottom", "none"),
  border = FALSE
)

Arguments

base_size

Base font size in points at final figure size.

base_family

Font family. "sans" maps to Helvetica/Arial.

grid

Grid lines: "y" (default), "both" or "none".

legend

Legend position: "right", "top", "bottom" or "none".

border

Draw a thin panel border (default FALSE).

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  lcz_theme_journal()
